sourceText:
Maple Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Saturday, November 16, 2013 - 11:00am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups AP flour
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 cup (1 stick) butter
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup white sugar
1 tablespoon maple syrup
1 egg
3/4 cup raisins
1/2 cup oats

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and line two baking sheets. 2 In a bowl blend flour, baking soda and cinnamon together.  Set aside. 3 Using your stand mixer, beat butter and sugar until creamy.  Add the egg and maple syrup.  Slowly add in the dry ingredients until a sticky dough forms. Add raisins and oats and fold into batter. 4 Drop about a teaspoon full of batter on each cookie sheet.  Should make about 24 cookies. 5 Bake for 8-10 minutes or until lightly golden.  Transfer to a cooling rack and enjoy!
